paper_title: Searches for signatures of ultra-light axion dark matter in polarimetry data of the European Pulsar Timing Array
notes: EPTA DR2 pulsar polarimetry search for ULDM axion-photon cosmic birefringence (g_agamma). Headline curve: the frequentist (GLSP) 95% C.L. upper limit, the dashed-gray line in Fig. 7 (e-print raster all_upper_lim.png). Extracted by pixel analysis: identified the lowest dark-gray curve (bottom envelope) with a rolling-minimum over a 60px window to bridge the dash gaps and reject upward artifacts where dash-gaps exposed the higher Bayesian curves. Axis calibration: x = frequency 1e-9..1e-6 Hz (log, plot box x=202..1332 px), top axis mass; y = g_agamma/(1e-12 GeV^-1) 1e3..1e-3 (log, y=133..855 px). Mass converted from oscillation frequency via m_a[eV] = nu[Hz]/2.418e14 (Eq.5, nu=m_a/2pi in natural units). g_agamma is directly the canonical coupling: paper Eq.(1) L = -1/4 F F + (g_agamma/4) a F Ftilde, same normalization/magnitude as the card's L=-(g_agamma/4) a F Ftilde. The frequentist limit starts at nu_min=1/T~2.4e-9 Hz (m_a~1e-23 eV), floor ~4.2e-14 GeV^-1, matching the paper's stated best sensitivity g95%=4e-14 GeV^-1 near m_a~8e-24-1e-23 eV (text on p.12; note the Conclusions p.14 misquote this as 5e-13, an internal typo). Curve rises smoothly ~power-law (slope~0.9) to ~9e-12 at m_a~4e-21 eV (1e-6 Hz). CHOICE OF CURVE: Fig.7 shows three combined gray curves - Frequentist(GLSP, dashed), Bayesian-conservative(solid, with PA^det systematics fit), and Bayesian-optimistic(dotted, 'no PA^det fit'). I report the frequentist because (i) it is the primary/model-independent analysis, (ii) the abstract's 'strong bounds ... in the mass range 6e-24-5e-23 eV' with best sensitivity at the lowest masses matches the monotonic frequentist curve (the conservative Bayesian is weak <3e-9 Hz), and (iii) its floor matches the quoted 4e-14. ALTERNATIVE: the conservative Bayesian (solid gray) reaches g95%=2e-13 at m_a=3e-23 eV (7.25e-9 Hz) and rises to a rising shoulder/(11yr)^-1 bump (~3e-11) at f<3e-9; the two curves agree within a factor ~2 for m_a>~3e-23 eV but diverge strongly at the lowest masses. DM density rho_0=rho_DM~0.4 GeV/cm^3 assumed (Eq.6; limit scales with local DM density, not rescaled per card). 95% C.L. Extraction_confidence lowered to reflect the frequentist-vs-conservative-Bayesian ambiguity in which curve the compilation digitised.
